aloha-burgers.name: Aloha Burgers
aloha-burgers.description: Our Aloha Burger is your ticket to flavor paradise! This juicy, Hawaiian-inspired patty is topped with sweet grilled pineapple, melted cheese, and a zesty sauce that brings the islands to your plate.
instructions: Form ground beef into 8 equal-sized patties.
Pur 1 cup teriyaki sauce over hamburger patties and marinate at least 30 minutes.
Pour remaining cup teriyaki sauce into bowl and let pineapple rings marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Grill patties over high heat about 3 minutes on each side for medium donees, longer for well-done burgers.
Burgers should reach an internal temperature of 160 degrees F.
Place 1 slice of cheese on each burger, let it melt before removing burgers from grill.
Grill pineapple rings over medium heat for 1 minute on each side.
Assemble with remaining ingredients.
Serve & ENJOY!

green-sauce-enchiladas.name: Salsa Verde Shredded Beef Enchiladas
green-sauce-enchiladas.description: Craving the ultimate cozy dinner? These Salsa Verde Short Rib Enchiladas don't miss and are your ticket to comfort food heaven! Tender, slow-cooked short ribs wrapped in warm tortillas, smothered in zesty salsa verde, and baked to cheesy perfection. Perfect for this up coming fall season, this recipe makes plenty for leftovers.
ingredients: For the meat: 2 lbs of any kind of roasted beef
For the salsa verde: 1 lb tomatillos, husked and rinsed
Depending on how hot your jalapeños. 2 for mild and 3 for spicier. Adjust the amount of peppers to your spice preference.
Shredded ice burg lettuce & avocado for garnish
instructions: You can either cook meat in a crockpot or cut into smaller pieces and boil on your stove top for roughly 2 hours. Combine the beef, onion, garlic, salt, bay leaves and enough water to submerge the beef. Bring it to boil and then reduce heat to medium, covered. Let that cook until the beef is fall apart tender. Remove the beef, shred and set aside.

Make the Salsa Verde. - In a pot, add tomatillos, jalapeños, garlic, onion. Cover with water and bring to a boil. - Reduce heat and simmer for about 10 minutes until tomatillos change color. Don’t over cook them. Drain. - In a blender, combine your produce, cilantro, chicken boullion and a pinch of pepper. Blend until smooth. In a large skillet pour in your salsa, cooking on medium. Then add your choice of cream (sour cream or crema) about 1/2 cup and mix together.

Prepare the Enchiladas:** - Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). - In a skillet, warm some oil over medium heat. Lightly fry each tortilla for about 10-15 seconds on each side until softened with a little crunch. Drain on paper towels.

Spread about ½ cup of salsa verde cream on the bottom of a baking dish. - Fill each tortilla with shredded beef, cheese of your choice and a drizzle of your enchilada sauce. Roll tightly and place seam-side down in the baking dish. - Once all tortillas are filled, and placed in the dish, cover the enchiladas with remaining salsa verde and sprinkle with cheese.
Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes. Remove foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.
Allow to cool for a few minutes. Serve with shredded lettuce, crema or sour cream, and cotija cheese.
Serve hot & ENJOY!

steak-strawberry-salad-1.name: Steak & Strawberry Salad
steak-strawberry-salad-1.description: This steak and strawberry salad is a celebration of love & flavors! The sweetness of the strawberries, richness of the steak, tang of the blue cheese crumble and the satisfying crunch of the nuts! Pair this with a glass of red wine and this meal sets the perfect romantic mood for celebrating love this Valentine's Day!
ingredients: 2 New York Steak (any steak will work)
½ cup of blue cheese crumbles
instructions: Start by prepping all of your ingredients. Washing your strawberries and thawing out your steak.
After the strawberries are washed, slice (we like slicing them vertically into heart shapes- especially if serving for Valentine’s Day) and set aside.
Next you’ll want to prep your steak! Coat your steaks with a little oil and season.
Heat up your pan to about medium, medium-high!

Once the pan is hot add your steak and cook until desired doness. Around 3-4 minutes (depending on steak thickness and desired doneness). Always remember- the best way to get the perfect steak is to use a meat thermometer!
Once your steak is cooked, set aside and let it rest for 5 minutes while you assemble your salad.
Start with your spring mix.
Next layer on your nuts and strawberries!
Then your steak and blue cheese crumble.
And lastly finish it off with some balsamic vinaigrette dressing and ENJOY!

korean-flanken-ribs.name: Korean Style Flanken Ribs
korean-flanken-ribs.description: These Korean-style flanken ribs are a true flavor explosion, perfect for any occasion. Personally, we love this recipe when we're short on time. It takes a small amount of effort to marinate ahead of time but once that step is completed, this meal is so quick and easy to prepare in under 30 minutes. The sweet and savory flavors, combined with tender, juicy beef, creates a dish that’s hard to resist.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and green onions to create the marinade.
Place the short ribs in a shallow dish or bag and pour the marinade over them, ensuring they are fully coated.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, but preferably overnight.
Use the same marinade and sauté your veggies. First carrots until tender then add your broccoli and sauté until softened.
Cook your 1 cup of white jasmine rice in 2 cups of water. Bring water to a boil add your rice bring that to a boil and then turn heat on low for 15 mins covered at all times.

Preheat your flattop grill to medium-high heat. Remove the ribs from the marinade and shake off any excess. Season with salt and pepper. Grill the ribs for about 3-4 minutes per side, or until they are cooked to your desired doneness.
Once cooked, remove the ribs from the grill and sprinkle with sesame seeds if desired.
Serve hot over a bed of rice and veggies. ENJOY!

egg-roll-bowls.name: Egg Roll Bowls
egg-roll-bowls.description: Egg Roll Bowls: A Quick and Healthy Twist on a Classic FavoriteIf you love the flavors of egg rolls but are looking for a healthier, low-carb option, then egg roll bowls are a great option. These deconstructed egg rolls are quick to make, packed with vegetables, and full of savory goodness. This recipe will walk you through creating this delicious meal that's sure to become a weeknight staple in your home!
ingredients: 1 tbsp ginger paste or freshly graded.
3 tbsp soy sauce (or tamari for gluten-free).
1 tsp Sriracha (optional, for a spicy kick)
3-4 green onions, sliced. Use the white end for sautéing and the bright green end for garnishing.
1 cup of cooked white jasmin rice, cauliflower rice, or quinoa rice for pairing.
instructions: Prep Your Ingredients: Begin by prepping all your ingredients. Dice the onion and green onion. Next either mince fresh garlic and ginger or use the paste. You can also shred your own cabbage and carrots or use the premixed bag of coleslaw at the store. Prepping your ingredients ahead of time makes the cooking process much quicker.

Cook the Meat: In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium-high heat. Add in your diced white onion and cook for 2-3 minutes. Next add the ground beef and cook until its close to browned. Break it up with a spatula as it cooks.
Sauté Aromatics: In the same skillet, add your diced celery and cook for 3-4 minutes. Next add the minced garlic and ginger, cooking for another minute until fragrant.

Cook the Vegetables: Add in your cabbage, shredded carrots and sliced white onion mixture. Stir well to combine. Cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring frequently, until the vegetables are tender but still have a bit of crunch.
Combine Everything:  Add the soy sauce, rice vinegar, oyster sauce and Sriracha (if using). Stir everything together and cook for another 2-3 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together.

Finish and Serve: Remove the skillet from the heat. Sprinkle the sliced green onions and sesame seeds over the top for garnish. Serve the egg roll mixture in bowls over a bed of cooked rice, cauliflower or quinoa rice for a lower-carb option.
Serve hot and Enjoy!

burger-tacos.name: Burger Tacos
burger-tacos.description: With this delightful burger taco recipe, you no longer have to choose between two beloved classics. By combining the best of burgers and tacos, you can create a culinary masterpiece that will wow your family and friends. Let your taste buds rejoice in the harmonious blend of flavors and textures, making burger tacos the perfect dish for any occasion. So, get creative in the kitchen and enjoy the best of both worlds with this delicious fusion recipe. Bon appétit!
ingredients: Your favorite burger toppings (shredded lettuce, chopped onion, avocado, tomato)
Burger Sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 3 tablespoons ketchup, 1/2 tablespoon white vinegar, 1/2 tablespoon granulated sugar, 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish
instructions: Prepare your burger sauce ahead of time and store in the refrigerator.
Prepare your favorite burger toppings (lettuce, avocado, onion are some of our favorites!) and store in refrigerator.
In a large bowl, season your ground beef with the paprika, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Mix throughout.
Divide and form 2oz burger balls. Try not to handle the ground beef too much.
Heat a large skillet or flat top grill to high heat, ungreased.
Place your burger balls down with a 6” tortilla over the top.

Use your burger press and press down firmly over the top of the tortilla, getting your ground beef as thin as possible. Let cook for 1 minute then press down again. Let cook for 2-3 minutes. Beef should be cooked through at this point.

Using strong metal spatula, flip and allow to cook tortilla side down for 30 seconds to a minute, depending on how crispy you want your tortilla. Top with cheese which will melt while tortilla is cooking.
Remove burger tacos from grill or skillet, drizzle burger sauce across the top, add your desired combination of burger toppings and enjoy!

cheese-burger-salad.name: Burger Salad
cheese-burger-salad.description: Craving a burger but want to cut out the bread? This is the perfect salad for you! It is super simple and quick to make. It will certainly leave you wanting seconds. And in case you couldn't already tell...it taste just like a burger!
ingredients: Burger sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 3 tablespoons ketchup, 1/2 tablespoon white vinegar, 1/2 tablespoon granulated sugar, 2 tablespoons sweet pickle relish
instructions: Diced up your lettuce, pickles and shred your cheese.
Cook your ground beef on medium and add your burger seasoning. (You can add ½ a diced onion if desired.)
Drain the fat, top with your shredded cheese to slowly melt and set to the side.
In a bowl mix together your burger sauce.
Next add your lettuce to a bowl and begin layering.
Add your ground beef & cheese.
Toss in your diced pickles.
Top with your burger sauce.
And finish it off with some fried onion crisps.
Serve & ENJOY!

elote-steak-tacos.name: Elote Steak Tacos
elote-steak-tacos.description: Prepare to indulge in a culinary fiesta with our tantalizing Elote Steak Tacos! These tacos are a celebration of bold Mexican flavors, featuring succulent steak infused with spices, grilled elote (Mexican street corn), creamy sauce, and vibrant toppings. Perfect for a festive gathering or a flavorful weeknight dinner. These tacos are best enjoyed fresh, with their irresistible blend of savory, smoky, and tangy flavors!
ingredients: 1 Steak of your choosing. Seasoned with salt, pepper and garlic powder
2 ears of corn, husked or 1 can of corn
Additional cotija cheese, ¼ red onion finely chopped and a sprinkle of cilantro for topping
instructions: Grill the Corn: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat. Place the husked corn directly on the grill grates and cook, turning occasionally, until charred in spots and tender, about 8-10 minutes. Remove from the grill and let cool slightly. If your cooking canned corn just use a pan and toasted until golden with a little butter.
Prepare the Corn: In a small bowl, mix together mayonnaise, sour cream, and lime juice to create the sauce. Sprinkle with crumbled cotija cheese, chopped cilantro and the seasonings.
Grill the Steak: Heat your pan or grill to a medium temperature and cook your steak until desired doneness.

Assemble the Tacos: Warm the tortillas on the grill or in a skillet until soft and pliable. Fill each tortilla with slices of grilled steak and your corn mixture. Sprinkle with additional cotija cheese and cilantro. Add red onions if desired and garnish with lime wedges.
Serve and Enjoy!

sirloin-tip-steak-mint-chimmichurri.name: Sirloin Tip Steak & Mint Chimmichurri
sirloin-tip-steak-mint-chimmichurri.description: Get ready to taste the awesome flavors of Argentina with our epic steak chimichurri recipe with a minty twist. It's all about that juicy grilled steak topped with zesty, herby and fresh chimichurri sauce. Come join us for a food adventure that combines the best meat and the freshest, tastiest herbs for a meal you won't forget! We have paired this with just a simple salad and a loaded bacon/corn & jalapeño baked potato! Talk about a comfort meal.
ingredients: Dash of salt and pepper to taste
½ tbsp of fresh mint leaves
½ cup of red wine vinegar
instructions: Season your steak with your favorite steak seasoning and set aside.
Prep your sides that you would like to serve. We chose a simple bag salad, prep and set aside.
Next bake your potatoes.
Cut and de-seed your jalapeños.
Dice your bacon and jalapeño into small pieces.
Toss a tablespoon of butter into a skillet and toast your corn on the cobb on medium until slightly golden. Set aside.
In the same pan add your bacon bites as well as your jalapeños and cook until bacon is close to finished.
While that is cooking cut your corn off your cobb.
When your jalapeños are cooked down toss in your corn and mix together. Add salt or pepper to taste and set aside.
Next you will want to dice up your fresh herbs, garlic and shallot.
Mix all of your ingredients for your chimmichuri together and set aside (oregano, parsley, garlic, shallot, mint, olive oil, red wine vinegar, lemon squeeze, red pepper flakes).
Lastly, you will need to heat up a skillet and toss in a little butter (tallow or oil will work).
Once your pan is hot add in your steak and cook until your desired doneness.
Finally slice open your baked potato and add sautéed jalapeño corn. Add your side salad. Slice into your steak and dip your steak into the chimmichuri sauce.
Optional: pair with a glass of wine and garlic bread!
Serve and enjoy!

left-over-steak-french-dip.name: Cheese Steak Sandwich
left-over-steak-french-dip.description: Do you have left over steak in the fridge? Not sure what to do with it? Well look no further and make this warm and comfy bell pepper french dip sandwich! It takes under 30 mins to make and will be sure to keep you warm on those chilly nights!
ingredients: Any left over cut of steak
Dash of salt, pepper and garlic powder
instructions: Prep your bell peppers and onions. Cut them into long strands and set aside.
Next toss a little butter to a hot skillet and heat up your left over steak on medium heat.
While that is cooking, take your au ju sauce packet and follow the direct on the packet. Heat up in a pot of water.
Remove your steak from the pan and set aside.
In the same skillet add your sliced veggies and cook until softened. Remove and set to the side. Season with just a little dash of salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Toss some more butter back into your skillet and add your slices of bread to the pan.
Layer on your choice of cheese. Here we used pepper jack cheese to bring out that peppery flavor.
Then add your steak and sautéed veggies.
Layer that with a little more cheese and top with another slice of bread.
Cook on both sides until golden. Pressing down on the sandwich to hold everything together.
Cut that sandwich in half and dip into that yummy warm au ju sauce!
You can pair this sandwich with whichever side you desire! Here we used a macaroni salad.
Garnish with a little fresh parsley for a pop of color. Serve & enjoy!

birria-tacos.description: Are you ready for mouth watering tender and juicy tacos? These birria tacos are the perfect comfort food combo that will warm you up on a cold day! Dip these crunchy cheesey tacos into the consomé (juice) and be prepared to blow your taste buds away!
ingredients: 3-4 lb chuck roast, cut into large chunks
3 tablespoons of beef bouillon (dry or paste)
Cilantro, purple onion and lemon/lime for garnish
instructions: Start by cutting your chuck roast into chunks. Then add them to a large pot and toss in your water making sure all of the meat is submerged.
Add a dash of salt to the water. Cover and cook on medium.
Next you’ll want to take your dried chilies and remove the stems and seeds. Add that to a hot skillet with a little olive oil and lightly toast your dried chillies.

In a blender, combine the chilies, garlic, onion, ground cumin, dried oregano, ground cloves, cinnamon, vinegar, and beef bouillon. Blend until you have a smooth sauce. You can add a little water to make this easier to blend.
Take a strainer and pour your sauce into your pot of beef.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let the birria simmer for about 2-3 hours, or until the beef is tender and the flavors have melded together.
Once the beef is tender, use a couple forks to shred the meat right in the pot. Allow the shredded beef to simmer in the sauce for an additional 15-20 minutes to soak up all the flavors.
To serve, fry up some corn tortillas and fill them with the beef birria and a lot of cheese.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and purple onion. Serve with lime wedges on the side for squeezing over the birria and a bowl of your consomé.
Serve and Enjoy!
birria-tacos.notes: Folding the corn tortillas can be a little tricky, to make it easier you can double up on the tacos so they do not break when you are frying them! Also when you are frying your dried chillies it is important to you lightly toast them. You do not want to make the chillies bitter.

low-carb-pizza-bowls.name: Low Carb Pizza Bowls
low-carb-pizza-bowls.description: Looking for a low carb meal that satisfies your savory craving? Pizza bowls are the ultimate comfort food this fall. These low-calorie and easy-to-assemble pizza bowls will have you coming back for seconds. It's a great way to sneak in veggies on your kids' plate or a guilt-free meal you can go back for seconds on!
ingredients: 1 jar of your favorite marinara sauce
Any additional toppings of your choice. We used pepperoni, mushrooms, bell pepper & basil.
instructions: Dice up all of your toppings. As well as ½ white onion.
Cook up your ground beef and throw in your diced onion and bell pepper. Season your beef with a dash or salt, pepper and garlic powder. Drain any excess fat.
After you’ve drained your fat pour in your marinara sauce. Mix well with your ground beef. Add italian seasoning for extra flavor.
Then you’ll add this sauce to a baking dish.
Sprinkle your toppings all over. Add mozzarella and parmesan cheese. Then top with pepperoni and basil.
Bake in the oven at 350 until cheese is slightly golden and bubbly.
Top with fresh parsley. Serve & enjoy!

cashew-beef-boats.description: These cashew boats offer great flavor and are versatile and customizable. The cashews add a delightful crunch and nutty flavor to this dish, complementing the savory taste of the Dot Seven Ground Beef. This dish is also healthy and refreshing. Using the lettuce leaves as boats provide a nutritious alternative to traditional bread or tortilla wraps. It also adds a crisp and hydrating element to the dish, making it a lighter option for a meal. Overall, these boats offer a tasty way to experience a combination of bold flavors while also incorporating nutritious ingredients and all in under 30 minutes!
ingredients: Salt, pepper, garlic powder for ground beef seasoning.
instructions: Prep your ingredients, dicing your onions, green onions and cashews.
Add a little oil to a skillet over medium/high heat and toss in your diced onions.
Cook for 1-2 mins and then add your ground beef. Season with garlic powder, a dash of salt and pepper.
Cook until browned or well-done.
In a separate skillet, lightly toast your diced cashews.
Add cashews to your skillet of ground beef and pour over your teriyaki sauce. Mix together.
Add about ¼ cup of your beef/cashew mixture in a single romaine leaf.
Drizzle spicy mayo or an aioli sauce over the top.
Sprinkle your green onions and sesame seeds until desired amount.
Serve warm and ENJOY!

steak-bell-pepper-pineapple-boats.name: Steak & Bell Pepper Pineapple Boats
steak-bell-pepper-pineapple-boats.description: This mouthwatering recipe for sirloin steak with bell peppers and pinapple will certainly leave you wanting more ! This dish combines the juicy and flavorful steak with the smoky sweetness of grilled bell peppers, creating a perfect harmony of flavors. It's a great option for a summer barbecue or a date night dinner at home. So, fire up your grill and give this recipe a try.
instructions: Place the steak in a shallow dish and pour in soy sauce, sesame oil, corn starch and some brown sugar to make the marinade. Make sure the steak is evenly coated. Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes, or overnight for a more intense flavor.
Mix together honey, sriracha, soy sauce. Add garlic powder and a dash of pepper. Adjust flavors to your desire.

Remove the steak from the marinade and let any excess marinade drip off. Place the steak in a skillet and cook for about 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare, or adjust the cooking time according to your desired level of doneness.
Remove the steak from the skillet. While the steak is resting, prepare the bell peppers. Cut them into thick slices, removing the seeds and membranes.
Dice beef into small, thin slices.
Saute your bell peppers until soft and then toss beef back into the pan and drizzle your sauce over the top.
Turn off the heat and throw in your chunks of pineapple.
Mix well, serve with a side white rice and ENJOY!

marinated-steak-kabobs.name: Marinated Steak Kabobs
marinated-steak-kabobs.description: Kabobs are a fantastic way to enjoy beef. Whether you're grilling them at a backyard barbecue or cooking them indoors, kabobs are a crowd-pleasing dish that never fails to impress.
instructions: Mix together marinade with ¼ cup olive oil, 2 tablespoons, soy sauce, 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar, 2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce, 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice, 2 cloves garlic, minced1 tablespoon brown sugar1 teaspoon paprika1 teaspoon onion powder½ teaspoon dried oreganoSalt and black pepper, to taste

For the Kabobs: 1 ½ pounds top sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch cubes1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut in 1-inch pieces1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and cut into 1-inch pieces8 ounces button mushrooms1 red onion, cut into 1-inch pieces that makes 8 metal skewers.
Let beef marinate for…
In a medium bowl, whisk together the oil, soy sauce, red wine vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, garlic, brown sugar, paprika, onion powder, oregano, salt, and pepper.

Place the steak in the bowl with the marinade or place both in a large Ziploc bag, making sure the meat is covered in the marinade. Chill in the refrigerator for at least one hour so the meat can tenderize, can marinate for up to 8 hours.

Carefully thread the marinated meat along with the veggies, alternating them on the skewer. Keep a little space between the pieces so they will cook evenly on the grill. Brush the meat and veggies with some of the remaining marinade. Discard the remaining marinade.
Grill the kabobs on high heat, for 8 to 10 minutes (depending on how you like your meat), turning the kabobs every couple of minutes.
Use tongs to remove the kabobs from the grill and let the meat rest for 5 minutes before serving.

scrambled-egg-toast.name: Scrambled Chorizo & Egg Toast
scrambled-egg-toast.description: Are you looking for a quick and satisfying breakfast option? Look no further than our  scrambled egg & all beef Chorizo toast! This simple, yet delicious, recipe combines the fluffiness of scrambled eggs with the crunchiness of toast, and the flavor explosion of the chorizo, creating a perfect harmony of flavors. Whether you're a busy professional or a student on the go, this recipe is sure to become your go-to breakfast option. So, let's get started!
instructions: Whisk together eggs and a splash of milk to give it that fluffiness.
In a hot non-stick pan cook up your chorizo until it has a slight crisp.
Combine egg mixture with your chorizo until eggs are the desired doneness.
Toast Sourdough bread.
Add scrambled eggs to the top of the toast.
Top it with some avocado and sprinkle on some diced bacon.
Add some cheese and your favorite sauce & enjoy!

chorizo-breakfast-burritos-1.name: Quick & Easy Chorizo Breakfast Burritos
chorizo-breakfast-burritos-1.description: These chorizo burritos are super easy and quick to make for those busy mornings! Also a perfect kids meal. Heck, you can even freeze them for later or tote them to your next camping trip or weekend event.
instructions: Cook chorizo in a non-stick pan until it has a slight crisp.
In a bowl, mix together your eggs with a splash of milk to make them fluffy.
Add a little garlic salt for flavor, mix in, then add the egg mixture to your pan.
Cook together the chorizo and eggs until scrambled.
Add shredded cheddar cheese to your scrambled eggs.
In a separate pan, cook your tortillas until desired doneness.
Add your chorizo scramble to your tortilla and enjoy!

sweet-savory-beef-chorizo-breakfast-slid.name: Sweet & Savory Beef Chorizo Breakfast Sliders
sweet-savory-beef-chorizo-breakfast-slid.description: These beef chorizo sliders will leave everyone begging for more! Packed with protein from our Dot Seven Ranch Beef Chorizo plus the addition of scrambled eggs and bacon (optional), these mini breakfast sliders will keep you satiated throughout the day. The best part? You don't have to choose between a sweet or savory breakfast. With the finishing honey glaze, you get both!
ingredients: ½ a pack of Hawaiian Rolls
½ lb of Dot Seven Beef Chorizo
instructions: In a non-stick pan cook half a pound of chorizo until it has a slight crisp.
Whisk together your eggs with a splash of milk to give it that fluffy texture. Combine egg mixture with chorizo. Cook until desired doneness.
Slice Hawaiian rolls horizontally to make sliders and layer the bottom with cheese of choice.
Add scrambled egg mixture to the top and sprinkle the bacon bits.
Put on top layer of the buns and brush with maple syrup. Sprinkle on Everything but the Bagel Seasoning and bake at 350 for 15-20 mins until golden.
Serve with a side of maple syrup for dipping and enjoy!

dot-seven-ribeye.bodyHtml:
Our ribeyes are certainly a fan favorite! We cook ours until about 130-140 degrees internal. Making the perfect medium rare steak! 


 

Tags: Beef, beef recipes, Homemade, Homemade meals, Steak, steaks

mississippi-pot-roast.bodyHtml:
Talk about a comfort food! This roast is perfect for nachos or tacos this summer! 

Tags: beef recipes, easy recipe, pot roast, slow cooker

shredded-beef-loaded-potato.bodyHtml: For this weeks Dinner on the Dot we chose a not-so-well-known beef cut known as osso bucco. This roast is technically a shank but can be cooked just like any other roast. It features a cross section of a marrow bone adding to that perfect rich beefy flavor. Don't have the osso bucco cut? No problem. This recipe can be adapted using any beef roast. We sure hope you enjoy!

taco-stuffed-shells.bodyHtml:
This may be our new favorite way to eat stuffed shells. If you're looking for an easy ground beef recipe that's a crowd pleaser this ones for you! 

Tags: beef recipes, easy recipe, ground beef, Home cooking, Homemade meals, pasta, quick and easy recipes

ground-beef-nachos.bodyHtml:
Nachos are always a family favorite and certainly a
crowd pleaser. This recipe will give you the best of both
worlds by cooking up your own chips and adding your
favorite toppings. Dot Seven Ground Beef will take this
recipe to the next level!
Tags: beef recipes, ground beef, nachos, quick and easy recipes, super simple dinner ideas

crispy-steak-fingers.bodyHtml:
This week's DInner on the Dot is easy and a definite crowd pleaser that even the kids will love! These steak fingers are really quick to make, can be served plain with a dipping sauce or tossed in BBQ sauce. They also double as great finger food or appetizers. For this recipe we used our Sirloin Tip Steak sliced thin. 

Ok... now I'm starving!

Tags: easy recipe, quick, sirloin tip, Steak, steak fingers

steak-strawberry-salad.bodyHtml:
SUPER Easy. SUPER Simple. Each one of these rich ingredients compliment each other so well to create the perfect salad. If you do not like blue cheese you can substitute that for parmesan cheese and still get all those good flavors. This is by far my favorite way to have a salad! You will certainly impress your loved one this Valentine's Day!

Tags: Salad, Steak, Strawberry, Valentine's Day

beef-chorizo-cheese-dip.bodyHtml:
You'll be ready to rock for Super Bowl with this appetizer! The good news is that this cheese dip doubles for use in killer quesadillas. This recipe is ready in no time at all so you won't have to worry about missing the game! 

Tags: cheese dip, chorizo, superbowl

fried-rice-teriyaki-skirt-steak.bodyHtml:
Welcome to Dinner on the Dot! Here you will find recipes, tips and tricks for preparing beef and other side dishes. We hope you enjoy!

This month we’re kicking it off with the best fried rice you’ve tasted. This fried rice is much like the rice you would get at an expensive tepenyaki restaurant. There are key elements that you cannot substitute in order to give this dish the authentic flavor. We paired this with a Dot Seven teriyaki skirt steak. The skirt steak is thin, long cut with visible grain. It comes from the short plate on the steer which is right under the rib section. The skirt steak is known more for its flavor rather than it’s tenderness which is why we chose to marinate this cut overnight. It is perfect for grilling or slicing thin to pan fry like we did in this case.

To save this recipe right click (on desktop) or tap and hold (on mobile) to save to your computer or photos for printing.

 

 

Tags: fried rice, pan fry, skirt steak
